summary: Phase 4 backend regression (Material Master + Variants + Bulk Import) — 30/30 pytest cases PASSED against the public preview URL. Covered: /api/seed idempotency & MAT-#### migration, POST/PUT/action/gm-approve/bulk-action on /api/materials with all role gates, word-limit and duplicate description guards, variants idempotency (case-insensitive) & un-approved gating, bulk-import summary/errors/needs_correction/template download, list filters + q search + counts, and master-audit action coverage (create, pm_approve, edit_requires_gm, gm_approve, pm_approve_bulk). No fixes required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3463 lines — approaching an unmaintainable size. Consider splitting into per-domain routers (materials, variants, imports, mrf, po, admin) in an upcoming refactor iteration.

In POST /api/import/materials the audit entity is 'material.bulk_import' with entity_id set to a floating-point timestamp string (batch_<epoch>). That entity_id is fragile for search/joins — recommend a stable batch id (uuid) instead.

PUT /api/materials/{uid}: 'gst_rate' change to the same numeric value passes updates dict truthy-check but old_snap comparison isn't done; a no-op edit still triggers pending_gm_approval + audit. Minor UX concern only, not a functional bug.
seed_data_creation: Tests create their own 'Regression Test Mat …' rows with time_ns() suffixes to avoid clashing with existing data. No production/seeded rows modified.
